items.title: How Bittensor Miners Helped Build One of AI’s Best Decision Models
items.body: A month-old Bittensor subnet built one of the top AI decision models out of miner submissions. Here’s what REAX did and why the big labs should care.

items.title: Engy (SN53) Handles More AI Tokens Than Venice Despite 28× Valuation Gap
items.body: Engy (SN53) processed over 3 trillion inference tokens in 30 days, surpassing Venice on reported volume despite a market cap nearly 28 times smaller.

items.title: The Future of AI Can’t Hang on One Man or One Board
items.body: Jensen Huang’s NVIDIA crisis exposes the risks of centralized AI. Can Bittensor build a future where intelligence is no longer controlled by one man or board?

items.title: Beam (SN105) Plugs Into Chainlink CRE. Here’s What Changed and Why It Matters
items.body: Beam has integrated Chainlink CRE, so smart contracts can now act on verified records of data transfers. We explain the integration, its limits and why…

items.title: Carbon (SN116) Goes Live on Bittensor Mainnet With First Physics AI Challenge
items.body: Carbon is live on Bittensor mainnet with its first physics AI challenge in motor design, rewarding validated surrogate models built for engineers.

items.title: Can TAO, Alpha, and Gamma Turn Bittensor Into an AI Economy?
items.body: Explore how TAO, alpha tokens, and Gamma could power Bittensor’s AI economy, and why repeat purchases from independent customers are the real test of demand.
